title: The right end of 1RB1RA_1LC0RD_1LD1LB_1LE0LF_0RA---_0LB1RE: a bouncer over long blocks, one phase proved
text: The tape is one irregular list of PR 93's digits followed by a few long periodic blocks that turn into one another while the head bounces; there are no halving chains, so the sibling's halving-chain engine does not apply. Lean proves the eat visit (three 1s eaten, two copies of 011 added) for all counts and k visits in a row. In 10<sup>10</sup> steps the leftward sweep never stepped onto the three-0 run a halt needs inside the tape.
